bio.text: Sean McCann, a Democrat, is a member of the Michigan State Senate representing District 19 and is the Democratic candidate for Michigan's 4th Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 election.
McCann previously served in the Michigan House of Representatives (District 60) from 2011 to 2015 and on the Kalamazoo City Commission from 1999 to 2008.
McCann earned a B.A. in political science from Western Michigan University in 1993.
McCann has worked as executive director of Kalamazoo Friends of Recreation, director of financial development of the American Red Cross, and executive director of the Vine Neighborhood Association.
